# Discovery call — SOC modernization (synthetic fixture)

Attendees: Dana R. (SOC Manager), Priya K. (Senior Detection Engineer). Elastic: AE, SA.

## Notes

- SOC team of 9 analysts, 24x7 coverage across two regions.
- Current SIEM is an on-prem log platform nearing renewal; licensing tied to ingest volume.
- Dana: "we are drowning in alerts and most of them are noise".
- Analysts spend 30-40 minutes per alert pivoting across four consoles before they have a hypothesis.
- Priya wants detections as code and a way to group related alerts into one investigation.
- Interest in an AI assistant that can explain an alert in plain language for junior analysts.
- Budget owner not identified on this call; Dana reports to the CISO.
- Ingest volume unknown — Priya to pull numbers from the current platform.
- Wants to see a demo in three weeks with their leadership.
